description: Fill a template: HWP, HWPX, DOCX, PDF or SVG. Mark what changes with {{name}}, or set literal to replace the sample text the design already shows ("홍길동"). One copy from values, or many from rows or a CSV/XLSX data file (one file per row, named by name_pattern, e.g. 100 business cards from one design). A list value in HWP/DOCX repeats a table row. Every copy is reopened: placeholders left and values not used are reported per file.

data.description: Many copies from a CSV or XLSX file: first row = keys, one copy per following row

literal.description: Keys of values or rows are the exact sample text in the template, not {{placeholders}}

match.description: With rows or data: sample text in the design → key of the row, e.g. {"홍길동": "name", "010-0000-0000": "phone"}. Use when the design has no {{placeholders}}

name_pattern.description: Many copies: file name with {{key}} and {{n}}, e.g. "card-{{name}}". Default "{{n}}-<template name>"

out.description: One copy: absolute output path, same extension as the template

rows.description: Many copies: one object per copy

sheet.description: data: sheet name for XLSX. Default the first

name: doc_create
title: Create from template
